messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 tail latency spike (SSE streams) detected in eu-west-1 - increased 5xx and chunk stalls. Paging oncall.
ryan_oncall: saw it — p95 ~1200ms -> 2k, p99 jumped to 9s for SSE endpoints. Error spike: 504s from proxy pool. Putting initial notes in thread.
maya_shift: I'm on it, joining now. Any customer-facing impact reported yet?
leah_support: two customers flagged streaming stall loops (reconnects every 30s). Observed stalled chunks where no bytes sent for ~6-8s before reconnect.
samir_infra: digging into proxy logs — we see many connections hitting proxy write backpressure, socket writables delayed. upstream runtime appears healthy, but backend flushes queued.
ryan_oncall: hypothesis: proxy corking/backpressure with small windowed writes + client slow consumers causing buffering. Also spikes correlate with a config change to proxy keepalive and pipeline max_window earlier today.
anna_ops: can we route new sessions to a healthy region while we triage? Risk: stateful sessions for some customers — need to confirm fallback behavior.
maya_shift: runbook step1: reduce per-connection write buffer to force frequent flushes? runbook step2: temporarily increase proxy worker count and lower proxy write_coalesce window. I'm going to flip write_coalesce -> 20ms on eu-west-1 canary.
samir_infra: patch queued: config change applied to 2 of 6 proxy pods in canary pool. Monitoring now. Command used:
```
kubectl patch deploy sse-proxy-eu --type='json' -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/WRITE_COALESCE_MS","value":"20"}]'
```
ryan_oncall: good. also enabling aggressive keepalive to avoid long-lived stalled sockets. Watch p99 and socket backlog.
leah_support: created support ticket and notified affected customers with brief description + mitigation steps. No escalations yet but they want ETA.
maya_shift: canary looks promising — p99 down from 9s -> ~2.1s on canary. Rolling to remaining pods in 10m. Continuing to monitor reconnect rates.
samir_infra: rolling completed. p95 stable ~900ms, p99 ~2s. proxy 504s reduced by 80%. Still seeing some residual stalls for very slow clients; may need client-side backpressure guidance in SDK.
ryan_oncall: follow-up actions: 1) revert risky keepalive change from this morning (cause analysis). 2) add metric for proxy write queue depth and per-connection stall time. 3) docs + SDK note for clients about read buffers. I'll handoff to maya for overnight watch.
maya_shift: taking handoff — I'll keep monitoring until midnight UTC, will alert if p99 > 3s or 504s > baseline + 10/min. Leaving a checklist in ops runbook.
anna_ops: status page update suggested? recommend: "degraded streaming performance in EU — mitigation rolling, no data loss, reconnects possible". Approve?
leah_support: approve, published now.
ryan_oncall: thanks everyone. postmortem: owner samir_infra. tagging for root cause: proxy config change + client slow consumers -> corking. Will add timeline and long-term fix (adaptive coalescing + per-client flow control)"
